name: Zanoah
overview: Zanoah is identified in Scripture as both a city in western Judah and a city in eastern Judah, highlighting its significance in the territorial divisions of the tribe of Judah (Joshua 15:34, 15:56). The inhabitants of Zanoah actively participated in the rebuilding efforts during Nehemiah's time, restoring the valley gate and contributing to the city's defenses (Nehemiah 3:13, 11:30). Additionally, Zanoah is connected to a descendant of Caleb through Jekuthiel, illustrating a personal lineage linked to this place (1 Chronicles 4:18). Together, these references emphasize Zanoah’s geographical, communal, and genealogical importance within the biblical narrative.
